design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (replacement_installation_projects). Step 0 draw, printed by `.venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/draw_counts.py env/env_0037_residential_hvac_company/tasks/replacement_installation_projects --task 0`: {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 4]}. Design fitted to it: the line-set change-order charge takes 5 factors, the progress installment (root) takes 4; one prerequisite problem, one value_input edge.

WHY A GOOD TEST. Douglas Prentice only asks to pay what is due before Thursday's installation, by ACH. To answer he needs the progress-installment rule (a scheduled project pays a progress installment), and that rule's prerequisite sentence 'The progress installment is fixed only after every change order the homeowner has confirmed carries its charge on the project ledger.' The records show change-order approval 2 (r2, confirmed 2026-10-01T15:47:31) with no change-order charge (the ledger has only change order 1, l_co1). Working out which write brings that state about leads to the change-order charging tool; what change order 2 is for (a new line set) the homeowner states when asked, which selects the line-set change-order rule. The difficulty is discovering an unbilled confirmed change order the customer never mentions, pricing it with five rules (one of which chooses how the refrigerant-history credit is computed), and only then computing a progress installment whose base depends on that charge, the financing account, the tune-up record and a change-order collection method that pulls the newest change order out of the share.

SCOPE LEDGER. Already occupied before this task: nothing (task 0). Claimed here: install_ext_line_set_change_order_charge -> bill_change_order_a6215d22 (agent, state_due, subject install_charge) and install_ext_progress_installment -> pay_progress_installment_728e8d1f (user, on_request, subject install_payment). Reserved headroom for task 1 (draw 2 prerequisite problems, factor counts [4,5,5]): the signing-week world where credits are writable inside the statutory cancellation window — member install credit, accessory member discount and the contract deposit (user) — none of which this task touches. The gate structure of the base charter makes install_credit and install_refund writable only inside the three-business-day window (within_cancellation_period applies to both) and makes install_charge writable only for a confirmed change-order number, so the scheduled-project world of this task can only bill change orders and take homeowner payments; the signing-week world of task 1 can take credits. The two worlds and the two cores (charge-then-progress vs credits-then-deposit) do not overlap.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. install_charge write (step 11): governing base policies install_contract_pricing (no gate), install_change_orders (gate homeowner_approved_change_order: 'A change order is billed only after the homeowner has confirmed a change_order_approval request for that change order number.' — authority system_record; evidence install_change_requests r2: install_id = the project, change_order_no 2, request_type change_order_approval, request_status confirmed; correlation (install_id, change_order_no) bound to the tool's install_id and change_order_no), install_accessories_and_protection, install_cancellation_after_rescission and install_scheduling_permit (their gates apply to install_credit, install_cancel and install_schedule, not to this charge: policy_scope). The base rule also says 'A change order cannot be added once the project is installed' — the project is scheduled, not installed, and r2 was confirmed before installation (2026-10-01 < 2026-10-08): satisfied. Cap: change orders may not exceed change_order_max_pct 20 percent of 11295.00 = 2259.00; 228.00 + 334.60 = 562.60 is within it. install_payment write (step 14): install_deposit_and_payment (no gate; its sentence on when the remaining balance falls due is superseded by the progress-installment rule through a declared overwrite) and install_financing_link (gate disbursement_after_install: 'A financing disbursement is posted only to a project that is installed.' — evidence install_projects status scheduled; this write is a homeowner payment, not a financing disbursement, so the rule is not engaged and holds). No time gate applies to either write, so temporal_feasibility is [].

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target object: project 3b6e0422-36b4-4774-93cc-56621e21edf9 (Harbison Advantage Series System, 3.5 tons, contract 11295.00, signed in-home 2026-09-14, scheduled for 2026-10-08, permit HIL-M-2026-04418, financing account approved for 8000.00 on the 18-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan). Change-order key: (install_id, change_order_no). r1 = change order 1, confirmed 2026-09-14T19:12:05, already charged by l_co1 228.00 (the homeowner describes it as extra ductwork where the new furnace meets the old ducts: six feet beyond the 10-foot allowance at 38.00); r2 = change order 2, confirmed 2026-10-01T15:47:31 and not charged — the only confirmed number without a charge. Its scope is not a field of any table (install_change_requests carries no scope); the homeowner, who approved it, states it when asked: '...the second one, which you okayed on the install manager's tablet last Thursday, was for a new copper line set, because he said the old lines were too small for the bigger unit.' Advantage's line_set_replacement_included is false, so the line-set change-order rule prices it. Rows entering the progress base: every install_charge (l_cp 11295.00, l_co1 228.00, l_pf 105.00 and the new change-order 2 charge) less every install_credit (l_mc 400.00); the deposit l_dep 1307.40 is a payment and is not in the base. Excluded by rule: the 2024-06-11 refrigerant charge (27 months back) and the 2024-05-14 and 2024-09-26 tune-ups (outside the 24-month window).

FACTOR CARD — install_ext_line_set_change_order_charge (baseline: 'the line-set change-order charge is the package's line_set_change_order_usd' = 895.00). (1) refrigerant_history_credit, METHOD, cross-difficulty service, multi-source: the tier selects how the credit is computed — leak search and refrigerant both billed in the 24-month window -> the credit is the leak-search labor billed (a sum over refrigerant_leak_search labor lines); refrigerant without a leak search -> the credit is the most recent refrigerant charge (a single latest line); no refrigerant -> none. Evidence: t2l4 349.00 leak search, t1l3 495.00 and t2l3 577.50 refrigerant; near-miss t3l3 330.00 (2024-06-11) outside the window; credit 349.00; baseline figure 519.71. (2) discovery_share, parameter: approval on/after the scheduling day -> 60, after signing before scheduling -> 80, on the signing day -> 100; evidence r2 2026-10-01 vs l_pf 2026-09-24; near-miss r1 (signing day); baseline figure 527.66. (3) member_change_order_discount, parameter, cross-difficulty plan: active AND >=5 consecutive terms -> accessory_discount_pct + 5; Gold, 8 terms -> 15; baseline figure 385.70. (4) promotional_financing_fee, parameter, cross-difficulty finance: deferred-interest -> 6, 0% equal-payment -> 4, else 0; approved 18-Month plan -> 4; baseline figure 323.46. (5) change_order_admin_fee, parameter, history: >=2 charged -> 95, one -> 45, none -> 0; l_co1 -> 45; baseline figure 289.60. All five at their fall-through: 895.00 (differs from 334.60). Multi-source factors: refrigerant_history_credit (leak-search lines AND refrigerant lines) and discovery_share (approval time AND permit-fee posting).

FACTOR CARD — install_ext_progress_installment (baseline: 'pp_standard_share_pct percent of the project's net amount' = 30 percent of 11562.60 = 3468.78). (1) progress_share_by_size, parameter, history: charges >=15000 -> 50, >=11000 -> 40, else 30; charges 11962.60 -> 40; baseline figure 1206.16. (2) financed_exclusion, parameter, cross-difficulty finance, multi-source (account status and amount_financed against the ledger's net): approved and below net -> amount_financed; 8000.00 excluded; baseline figure 4376.68. (3) upkeep_factor, parameter, cross-difficulty plan: completed tune-ups (forfeited visits never counted) in 24 months >=4 -> 0.80, >=2 -> 0.90, else 1.00; v3, v4, v5 = 3 -> 0.90; near-miss v2 2024-09-26 exactly 24 whole months back (counted, 4 -> 0.80); baseline figure 1625.80. (4) change_order_collection, METHOD, history: three or more confirmed approvals -> every change-order charge is taken out of the share base and collected in full; exactly two -> only the change-order charge with the highest change-order number is; fewer -> all stay in the share base. r1, r2 -> the newest charge (change order 2, 334.60) is collected in full; baseline figure 1282.54. All four at fall-through: 3468.78 (differs from 1496.68).

OVERWRITE DECLARATIONS. install_change_orders: the sentence 'Work beyond the package scope is billed only through a numbered change order: a new line set at line_set_change_order_usd where the package does not include one, duct modification ... and other scope at the price written on the change order.' is replaced by the extended sentence that prices the line set at 'the line-set change-order charge worked out under this rule' and keeps duct and other-scope pricing unchanged; base params stay valid. install_deposit_and_payment: 'The remaining balance is due final_payment_due_days after installed_date, and 0 means on the installation day' is replaced by the sentence that a scheduled project takes a progress installment ahead of its installation day and the rest stays due final_payment_due_days after installed_date. No gate sentence is quoted by either overwrite, so every base gate stays inherited.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root install_ext_progress_installment (user tool pay_progress_installment_728e8d1f). Edge -> install_ext_line_set_change_order_charge: kind value_input, gate pp_net, form state, prerequisite sentence 'The progress installment is fixed only after every change order the homeowner has confirmed carries its charge on the project ledger.' Four-point test: ordering connective 'only after' (affirmative direction, the way a billing desk states that an installment rests on a complete ledger); the waited-on side is a record-visible state (a change-order charge standing on the ledger for every confirmed approval) with no action, performer or tool; no tool name, policy id or snake_case token; strength 'only after' and scope 'every change order the homeowner has confirmed' match the condition exactly. Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: the line-set change-order policy's charging tool (no other policy books change-order charges). Derivation: sentence + records (r2 confirmed, no charge for number 2) + the line-set change-order rule ('billed as a numbered change order') -> charge change order 2. Seed evidence of falsity: install_change_requests r2.request_status = confirmed, r2.change_order_no = 2, install_ledger l_co1.change_order_no = 1 (no entry for 2). Topological order: change-order charge (step 11) then progress installment (step 14). Deletion sensitivity: skipping step 11 moves the installment from 1496.68 to 1308.00 and leaves the ledger without the 334.60 entry. The persona never mentions the change order except in a passive branch that fires after the agent explains it; neither tool validates the prerequisite.

SEED ROW ROLES. customers (identity: phone 6145554362, address 4518 Leppert Rd, PIN 2864). equipment: the 2008 Rheem 3-ton R-22 condenser being replaced (the service calls and the line set concern it) and its furnace. plan_agreements Gold, active, consecutive_terms 8 (enrolled 2019-04-02) decides the member change-order discount; plan_service_entries: three renewal grants and five seasonal tune-ups (2024-05-14 and 2024-09-26 outside the 24-month window) decide the upkeep factor and keep visits_remaining 1 consistent (2-2, 2-2, 2-1). service_tickets/lines: three Standard no-cool calls, each with the 89.00 diagnostic fee fully offset by the Gold member diagnostic rate, R-22 at 165.00 per pound (2.0, 3.0, 3.5 lb), and on 2026-06-30 the leak search (349.00 labor, Gold 15 percent member repair discount 52.35) that the more-than-4-lb-in-12-months rule required — these select and compute the refrigerant-history credit (leak search and refrigerant both billed -> the leak-search labor). finance_accounts: 18-Month 0% plan approved 8000.00 (tier_2 is eligible; funding waits for completion, so funded_date is empty and payment_due_day stays 0 until funding sets it) decides the fee tier and the financed exclusion. install_projects and install_ledger: contract charge, member credit 400.00 (the member install credit rule on the signing date), change order 1 charge 228.00, deposit 1307.40 (the contract deposit rule on the signing date: Gold rate 12 percent of 10895.00, one completed tune-up in the current annual term so no upkeep reduction), permit fee 105.00 posted when scheduled. install_change_requests r1 and r2 (two confirmed approvals) decide the change-order points and the discovery share and carry the prerequisite. No automatic clause fires at frozen_time: the cancellation period ended 2026-09-17, funding waits for completion on 2026-10-08, no plan dues are owing, no service invoice is open.

PERSONA DESIGN. A precise retired tool-and-die maker who wants things squared away; volunteers only the goal (pay what is due before Thursday's installation) and a hard preference (ACH from checking, not a card). Given only when asked: phone, address, PIN, the 8000 financing, his Gold membership, and what each change order was for (ductwork at signing; a new copper line set okayed last Thursday). Passive branches: agrees to the line-set change order only after the agent explains it and quotes its amount; makes the ACH payment himself when handed the tool, for exactly the amount given; asks once whether it covers what is due ahead of Thursday and accepts the answer; ends after the confirmation reference. He never states amounts, credits, rules or the change order on his own, and does not correct a wrong figure.

REACHABILITY WALK. Turn 1: goal + ACH preference. Agent asks identity -> phone and address (verify K=2). Agent reads the project (scheduled, financed), ledger, change requests (finds r2 without charge), equipment, service history, plan, financing. KB: the progress-installment rule names the prerequisite sentence; the line-set change-order rule prices change order 2. Agent asks what change order 2 was for (answer: a new copper line set), explains it must be charged first and quotes 334.60; customer agrees (persona branch). Agent unlocks and calls the charging tool (synchronous, same frozen_time). Agent reads tune-up history, computes 1496.68, unlocks the payment tool and hands it over; customer calls it with payment_method ach; the receipt returns the confirmation reference he reads back. Nothing waits on a real-world event: the change-order approval was confirmed before the call, the charge and the payment are synchronous writes.

CARELESS ERRORS AND HOW THEY ARE EXCLUDED. Paying 3468.78 (base 30 percent of the net, ignoring the factor documents); computing the installment on the opening ledger (1308.00) without charging change order 2; charging change order 2 at the list 895.00; crediting the most recent refrigerant charge (577.50) although a leak search was billed; taking r1's signing-day approval for the discovery share (100 percent); counting the 2024-09-26 tune-up that sits exactly 24 months back (4 visits -> 0.80); collecting both change orders in full (that needs three approvals) or neither; using the deposit 1307.40 as a credit; excluding the full net instead of the 8000.00 financed.

STANDARD SOLUTION. Reads: find_customers, verify_customer_identity, find_install_projects, find_install_ledger, find_install_change_requests, find_equipment, find_service_tickets, find_service_lines, find_plan_agreements, find_finance_accounts. Write 1 (step 11): bill_change_order_a6215d22(install_id, customer_id, change_order_no=2, amount=334.60) = round((895.00 - 349.00) x 0.60 x 0.85 x 1.04 + 45.00, 2). Read find_plan_service_entries. Write 2 (step 14, homeowner): pay_progress_installment_728e8d1f(install_id, customer_id, amount=1496.68, payment_method=ach) = round(max(0, 11562.60 - 8000.00 - 334.60) x 40/100 x 0.90 + 334.60, 2).

VERIFICATION RUN. Values recomputed with the gate machinery (handling-time replay of gold writes, then compute): change order 334.60, installment 1496.68; factor substitutions CO: refrigerant 519.71, discovery 527.66, member 385.70, fee 323.46, admin 289.60, all 895.00; PP: share 1206.16, financed 4376.68, upkeep 1625.80, change-order collection 1282.54, all 3468.78; prerequisite skip -> 1308.00. Final rounding uses round-half-up (an epsilon of 0.000001 before rounding to the cent), so declared figures follow the rules' half-up wording. Gates (DIFF=env/env_0037_residential_hvac_company/tasks/replacement_installation_projects, round 2): check_extended, check_task_tools, replay_tasks, check_solvability, check_compute, check_grounding, check_cross_fire all OK.

CLOSURE. policy -> tool -> computation -> GT call -> terminal state: line-set change-order charge -> bill_change_order_a6215d22 -> computations[0] step 11 amount 334.60 -> new install_charge change_order 2 and project_balance 10255.20; progress installment -> pay_progress_installment_728e8d1f -> computations[1] step 14 amount 1496.68 -> new install_payment progress_payment (ach) and project_balance 8758.52. charter_scope = required_documents = [install_ext_line_set_change_order_charge, install_ext_progress_installment]; task_tools in first-call order. Solvability evidence vs GT: the change-order gate binds r2's install_id and change_order_no to the call's install_id and change_order_no; the disbursement gate binds the project's install_id. Draft recomputation from the visible context (KB prose as written in the rules, tool schemas, records reachable by the finders, persona lines) gives the same object (project, change order 2), the same order (charge, then installment) and the same figures 334.60 and 1496.68.

REVISIONS (round 1). (a) Symptom: the first progress design added a deposit catch-up measured against the base deposit formula; root cause: the contract-deposit rule of this charter computes the required deposit differently, so two policies would give two answers for one deposit; change: replaced that factor by change_order_points (confirmed approvals), reseeded the signing-date deposit to the contract-deposit rule's figure 1111.29 and the member credit to the member-install-credit rule's 400.00; re-run: COMPUTE OK. (b) Symptom: replay reported dangling foreign keys for empty-string references; root cause: empty id fields were "" instead of null; change: empty foreign keys seeded as null; re-run: REPLAY OK. (c) Symptom: the planted tune-up near-miss (2024-05-14) did not change the upkeep tier; root cause: the in-window count stayed at the top tier either way; change: the 2024 heating tune-up moved to 2024-09-26, exactly 24 whole months back, so the window holds 3 visits (factor 0.90) and a reader who counts it lands on 0.80; installment recomputed 1474.86; re-run: COMPUTE OK.

REWORK ROUND 2 (policy-task audit). T0-1: the scope of change order 2 was on no record; the persona now answers, only when asked what a change order was for, that the first was extra ductwork and the second a new copper line set (the homeowner approved both, so the scope is his own statement), and the tracing and required inputs cite that line. G1/T0-2: the mislabelled multipliers were relabelled parameter (discovery_share, upkeep_factor) and each computation gained an honest method: the refrigerant-history credit now selects its algorithm (leak-search labor sum vs latest refrigerant charge vs none) and the progress installment's change-order collection selects which change-order charges leave the share base (all / the newest / none), replacing change_order_points. G3: pp_visits now counts only entry_reason completed_visit, as the rule says ('never counting a visit forfeited...'). The signing-date deposit seed was recomputed under the revised contract-deposit rule (1307.40) and the project balance with it (9920.60). Observation on factor_trace multi-source labels: corrected (member discount and promo fee no longer claimed multi-source). Re-run figures: 334.60 / 1496.68.

REWORK ROUND 3 (policy-task audit revision_2). N5: the progress installment's change-order collection no longer reads 'the most recently posted' charge (undetermined for two charges posted the same day); it now takes the change-order charge carrying the highest change-order number, which base numbering makes the most recently approved one (compute: MAX change_order_no, then the charge with that number). On this world change order 2 is both, so 1496.68 is unchanged. N2: the progress policy's inputs.history now lists entry_reason completed_visit. N3: the member-credit mid tier now reads 'the most recently posted repair_labor charge' (line level, as the compute takes it). N4: the + 0.000001 before rounding is kept so that half-up rounding is applied to binary floats; no value lies within 1e-6 of a half-cent boundary. Gates re-run: all OK.
user_scenario: You are Douglas Prentice, sixty-seven, a retired tool-and-die maker in Hilliard who likes things squared away ahead of time. Harbison is replacing your furnace and air conditioner this Thursday, and you are calling because you want to pay whatever is due ahead of the installation so nothing holds the crew up. You want it to come straight out of your checking account by ACH; you do not like putting big amounts on a card. You open by saying your new system goes in on Thursday and you would like to pay what is due before the installation, from your checking account. When the representative asks who you are, you give your name and the phone number on the account, 6145554362. If they want a second detail, you give your street address, 4518 Leppert Rd; only if they ask for a PIN do you say 2864. You do not know what is due right now; that is exactly why you called, and you remember the contract only as somewhere around eleven thousand dollars. Only if the representative asks about financing do you say that you took Harbison's eighteen-month no-interest plan for eight thousand dollars of it and that the bank approved it the day after you signed. Only if they ask about your Comfort Club membership do you say you have been a Gold member for years and have the tune-ups done every spring and fall. If the representative asks what a change order on the job was for, you can tell them: the first one, which you okayed the evening you signed, was for some extra ductwork where the new furnace meets the old ducts; the second one, which you okayed on the install manager's tablet last Thursday, was for a new copper line set, because he said the old lines were too small for the bigger unit. If the representative explains that a change order for a new copper line set has to be put on your account first and tells you its amount, you say you remember okaying that on the install manager's tablet last week, and that they should go ahead. You do not bring up change orders, credits or fees yourself. When the representative tells you the amount due now and hands the payment over to you, you make the payment yourself by ACH for exactly the amount they gave you, and you read back the confirmation reference you receive. If the amount surprises you, you do not argue the arithmetic; you ask once whether that covers what is due ahead of Thursday and accept the answer. Once the payment has gone through and you have the confirmation reference, you thank them and end the call.

seed_consistency.check: Advantage Series 3.5 tons priced at price_3_5_tons_usd 11295.00; signed in-home 2026-09-14; cancellation period ended 2026-09-17; scheduled 2026-09-24 for 2026-10-08, later than the two-business-day lead; balance 11295.00 + 228.00 + 105.00 - 400.00 - 1307.40 = 9920.60.
Contract-price charge 11295.00 posted on the signed_date, as the install_contract trigger books it.

Member install credit 400.00 naming the contract-price charge: Gold install_credit_usd 250 + tenure bonus 150 (89 months since 2019-04-02, auto_renew), one system, no late fee, no tier upgrade; repair charges in the prior 12 months 349.00 (below 600), so no repair-to-replace credit — the member install credit rule as of 2026-09-14.
Change order 1 (duct transitions six feet beyond the 10-foot allowance at 38.00 per foot = 228.00), confirmed by r1 on the signing evening and charged the same day.

Deposit 1307.40 by check at signing: the contract deposit rule on 2026-09-14 gives the Gold member rate 12 percent of the net price 10895.00 (11295.00 less the 400.00 member credit, no accessory) = 1307.40; the agreement is billed annually and its current term (from 2026-04-02) had one completed tune-up, so the seasonal-upkeep factor stays 1.00; above deposit_min_usd 500; no upgrade or air-quality accessory.
Hilliard permit fee 105.00 posted when the project was scheduled on 2026-09-24 with permit HIL-M-2026-04418.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the homeowner's profile from the phone number he gives.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed to the customer reference this lookup returns.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify the caller with two details on file: phone number and service address.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No account detail may be discussed and no payment taken until identity is verified.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Find the scheduled Advantage Series project: status, signed_date, contract price, financing account and installation day.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identifies the project the progress installment is for and shows it is scheduled, which is when a progress installment is taken.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read every charge, credit and payment on the project, including the permit_fee charge date and the change-order charges already posted.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The progress base (every charge less every credit), the progress share by charges total, the scheduling day (permit_fee posting), the count of change orders already charged and the change-order charge with the highest change-order number all come from these entries; it also shows that no charge carries change order 2.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the homeowner's change-order approvals on the project with their status, number and confirmation time.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Reveals the prerequisite: change order 2 is confirmed (2026-10-01) but has no charge on the ledger, while 'The progress installment is fixed only after every change order the homeowner has confirmed carries its charge on the project ledger.'; it also gives the confirmation time the discovery share reads and the count of confirmed approvals the change-order points read.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the equipment at the address, including the 3-ton R-22 condenser being replaced.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Confirms the replaced unit the service calls and the line-set change order concern.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the homeowner's Harbison service calls on the replaced condenser.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The refrigerant-history credit is read from refrigerant charged on these calls; the dates place each call inside or outside the 24-month window.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the invoice lines of those calls, in particular the refrigerant charges and their posting dates.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Finds the 2026-06-30 refrigerant_leak_search labor (349.00) and the refrigerant charges in the 24 months before today (495.00, 577.50), which select and compute the refrigerant-history credit; the 2024-06-11 charge is outside the window.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.install_id: 3b6e0422-36b4-4774-93cc-56621e21edf9. Basis: the tool docstring says install_id is 'the reference number of the installation project being charged, as shown by the installation project lookup for this homeowner', and find_install_projects (step 2) returns exactly one project for this customer, the scheduled Harbison Advantage Series System. Uniqueness: the customer holds no other project, so no other id is reachable.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.customer_id: d9aab8cd-76da-4f54-990a-c62747047035. Basis: docstring 'the reference number of the homeowner who signed the contract, as shown by the customer profile lookup'; find_customers (step 0) returned this profile and the project row carries the same customer_id. Uniqueness: one profile matches 6145554362.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.change_order_no: 2. Basis: install_change_requests r2 (step 4) is the change_order_approval with request_status confirmed and change_order_no 2, while the ledger (step 3) shows only change order 1 charged; the docstring requires 'the approved number (1 or higher), exactly as it appears on the homeowner's change-order approval', and the rule says 'The line-set change order is charged once, under the change-order number the homeowner approved'. Uniqueness: change order 1 already carries its charge (l_co1), so 2 is the only confirmed number without one; 0 is reserved for non-change-order entries. What change order 2 is for is reachable from the homeowner himself: asked what the change order was for, he says 'the second one, which you okayed on the install manager's tablet last Thursday, was for a new copper line set', so the line-set change-order rule (Advantage's line_set_replacement_included is false) prices it; change order 1 he describes as the extra ductwork already charged.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 334.60. Scope: a new line set, from the homeowner's answer 'the second one, which you okayed on the install manager's tablet last Thursday, was for a new copper line set'. Refrigerant-history credit: the calls in the 24 months before 2026-10-05 billed a refrigerant_leak_search (349.00 labor, 2026-06-30) and refrigerant, so the credit is the leak-search labor 349.00. Discovery share: approval r2 confirmed 2026-10-01, on/after the 2026-09-24 permit_fee posting -> 60 percent. Member change-order discount: Gold active, consecutive_terms 8 >= 5 -> 15 percent. Promotional-financing fee: approved 18-Month 0% plan -> 4 percent. Administration fee: one change-order charge already posted -> 45.00. (895.00 - 349.00) x 0.60 x 0.85 x 1.04 + 45.00 = 334.5984 -> 334.60.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the agreement's visit grants and completed tune-up visits with their dates.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The upkeep factor counts tune-up visits in the 24 months before today (3) and excludes the 2024-05-14 and 2024-09-26 visits.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Hand the progress-installment payment tool to the homeowner.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Paying the installment is the homeowner's own action; the agent unlocks it for him. No DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The homeowner pays the progress installment from his checking account.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.install_id: 3b6e0422-36b4-4774-93cc-56621e21edf9. Basis: docstring 'the reference number of the installation project being paid, given to the homeowner by the agent from the installation project lookup'; the agent hands over the same project it read at step 2 and charged at step 11. Uniqueness: the only project of this homeowner.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.customer_id: d9aab8cd-76da-4f54-990a-c62747047035. Basis: docstring 'the reference number of the homeowner's customer profile, given to the homeowner by the agent from the customer profile lookup'; same profile as steps 0-1. Uniqueness: one profile.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 1496.68. At handling time (after step 11): charges 11295.00 + 228.00 + 105.00 + 334.60 = 11962.60 -> share 40 percent; credits 400.00 -> net 11562.60; approved financing 8000.00 below the net -> excluded; two confirmed change-order approvals -> the change-order charge with the highest change-order number (change order 2, 334.60) is collected in full; completed tune-ups in 24 months = 3 -> upkeep 0.90. max(0, 11562.60 - 8000.00 - 334.60) x 0.40 x 0.90 = 1162.08; + 334.60 = 1496.68. On the opening world (change order 2 not charged) the figure would be 1308.00.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.payment_method: ach. Basis: the persona says 'You want it to come straight out of your checking account by ACH'; the docstring defines 'ach — the homeowner pays by electronic transfer from a checking or savings account'. Uniqueness: card is a debit or credit card (he refuses a card), check is a paper check (not offered), financing is reserved for lender funding and never the homeowner's own payment.

edges.condition: Every install_change_requests row of request_type change_order_approval and request_status confirmed on the project has an install_ledger install_charge entry of line_type change_order carrying the same change_order_no.
edges.policy_source: The progress installment is fixed only after every change order the homeowner has confirmed carries its charge on the project ledger.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Change-order approval 2 is confirmed on the project, but the ledger carries a change-order charge only for change order 1, so not every confirmed change order carries its charge.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 11 posts an install_charge of line_type change_order with change_order_no 2 (334.60), so both confirmed approvals carry charges; pp_charges rises from 11628.00 to 11962.60, pp_net from 11228.00 to 11562.60, and the change-order charge with the highest change-order number (2) is 334.60.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a single edge (progress installment -> line-set change-order charge); there are no parallel prerequisites, and the prerequisite sentence pins the charge ahead of the installment.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping step 11 leaves change order 2 uncharged: the scored progress installment falls from 1496.68 to 1308.00 (net 11228.00, highest-numbered change-order charge 228.00 (change order 1): (11228.00 - 8000.00 - 228.00) x 0.40 x 0.90 + 228.00), and the ledger lacks the 334.60 change-order entry.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to 'pay what is due before the installation'; it never names the change order, its charge or any unbilled item; the line set appears only in a passive branch that fires after the representative explains a change order must be charged first ('If the representative explains that a change order for a new copper line set has to be put on your account first...'), and the persona says 'You do not bring up change orders, credits or fees yourself.'
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: pay_progress_installment_728e8d1f creates the progress_payment entry and adjusts project_balance unconditionally; it never reads change orders or checks any prerequisite, so calling it with change order 2 uncharged still writes faithfully (at whatever amount is passed). bill_change_order_a6215d22 likewise writes the charge without checking the approval.

factor_trace: refrigerant_history_credit (method, cross-difficulty service, multi-source): the homeowner's service calls in the 24 months before 2026-10-05 billed both a refrigerant_leak_search (t2l4, 349.00 labor, 2026-06-30) and refrigerant (t1l3 495.00, t2l3 577.50), so the credit is computed as the leak-search labor billed in the window = 349.00 (not the most recent refrigerant charge 577.50, which is the second tier's method); t3l3 330.00 on 2024-06-11 lies outside the window; the baseline (no credit) gives 519.71.

discovery_share (parameter): the most recent confirmed change-order approval r2 (2026-10-01T15:47:31) is on/after the permit_fee posting l_pf (2026-09-24), selecting co_after_schedule_share_pct 60 percent; near-miss r1 confirmed on the signed_date would give 100; the baseline (100 percent) gives 527.66.

member_change_order_discount (parameter, cross-difficulty plan): the Gold agreement is active with consecutive_terms 8 >= 5, selecting accessory_discount_pct 10 + co_loyal_extra_pct 5 = 15 percent; the baseline (no discount) gives 385.70.

promotional_financing_fee (parameter, cross-difficulty finance): the project's financing account is approved on the 18-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan, selecting co_equal_promo_fee_pct 4 percent; the baseline (no fee) gives 323.46.
change_order_admin_fee (parameter, history): exactly one change-order charge (l_co1, 228.00) is already posted, selecting co_admin_fee_second_usd 45.00; the baseline gives 289.60.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: calls billed both a refrigerant_leak_search and refrigerant: credit = leak-search labor billed
approval confirmed on or after the day the permit_fee charge was posted
active agreement with consecutive_terms of at least co_loyal_terms
approved account on an 18-Month or 36-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan
exactly one change-order charge already posted

factor_trace: progress_share_by_size (parameter, history): every charge at handling time = 11295.00 + 228.00 + 105.00 + 334.60 (change order 2 charged at step 11) = 11962.60, within [11000, 15000), selecting pp_mid_share_pct 40; the baseline (30) gives 1206.16.

financed_exclusion (parameter, cross-difficulty finance, multi-source: account status AND amount_financed against the ledger's net amount): approved, 8000.00 below the net 11562.60, so 8000.00 is excluded; the baseline (nothing excluded) gives 4376.68.

upkeep_factor (parameter, cross-difficulty plan): completed tune-up visits in the 24 months before 2026-10-05 = v3 2025-05-12, v4 2025-10-09, v5 2026-05-20 = 3 (v2 2024-09-26 is 24 whole months back, v1 28 months back; no forfeited visit exists), at least 2 and fewer than 4, selecting pp_low_upkeep_factor 0.90; the baseline (1.00) gives 1625.80.

change_order_collection (method, history): exactly two confirmed approvals (r1, r2), so only the change-order charge carrying the highest change-order number (change order 2, 334.60) is taken out of the progress base and collected in full; with three or more every change-order charge would be, with fewer none; the baseline (every change order stays at the share) gives 1282.54.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: charges total at least pp_mid_total_usd but less than pp_large_total_usd
approved account whose amount_financed is below the net amount
at least pp_kept_visits_low but fewer than pp_kept_visits_high completed visits
exactly pp_collect_latest_count confirmed approvals: the change-order charge with the highest change-order number collected in full
